title: Markdown RAG Chunker
description: Create RAG-ready Markdown chunks with header-aware structure, token-aware sizing, and predictable run limits.

input_mode.title: Input Mode
input_mode.description: Use text to paste Markdown directly. Use file to load and convert a supported file format from an HTTP(S) URL or kvs://KEY.

markdown_text.title: Markdown Text
markdown_text.description: Paste Markdown content here when input_mode is text.
markdown_text.default:
# Header 1
Hello, World!
## Header 2
Goodbye, World!

markdown_file.title: Markdown File Source
markdown_file.description: When input_mode is file, provide an HTTP(S) URL to Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, JSON, XML, EPUB, and more. You can also provide an Apify Key-Value Store record like kvs://MARKDOWN_INPUT.

headers_to_split_on.title: Headers to Split On
headers_to_split_on.description: Markdown header levels to split on, such as ['#', '##']. Most RAG pipelines work best with ['#', '##', '###']. Content under headers not listed is merged into parent sections.

strip_headers.title: Strip Headers
strip_headers.description: When true, header text is moved to metadata only. Use true for embedding pipelines and false for human-readable chunks.

max_chunk_chars.title: Max Chunk Chars
max_chunk_chars.description: Optional cap for chunk length in characters. Only oversized chunks are re-split (with 10% overlap); smaller sections pass through untouched. A common starting point is 1800 chars (about 450 tokens).

skip_if_unchanged.title: Skip if Unchanged
skip_if_unchanged.description: Skip re-chunking when the source document and split settings are unchanged since the last run: nothing is pushed to the dataset and the run costs a fraction of a cent. The Output reports unchanged=true with the cached chunk count. Recommended for scheduled and recurring pipelines. First runs always process.

max_input_chars.title: Max Input Chars
max_input_chars.description: Hard limit for input size in characters. Runs fail fast when exceeded to protect cost and runtime.

max_chunks.title: Max Chunks
max_chunks.description: Safety cap on total output chunks. Increase only for very large documents.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Route the remote file fetch through Apify Proxy (datacenter). Billed by Apify as standard platform usage. Leave off for direct downloads. Only applies in file mode.

proxy_url.title: Custom Proxy URL (free)
proxy_url.description: Bring your own proxy for the file fetch: http://user:pass@host:8080, https://host:8080, or socks5://host:1080. Free of charge — no Apify proxy fees. Mutually exclusive with Use Apify Proxy. Only applies in file mode. Leave empty for a direct (free) fetch.
